title: BattleOf2075 Official Trailer（only 3.1 MB three.js RTS game)
author: anloren
selftext:
This isn’t a tech demo. Battle of 2075 is a complete, playable 3D RTS packed into just 3.1 MB, developed with Gemini 4 Neon in Antigravity using Three.js, with zero external art or audio assets.



Inside those 3.1 MB:

• 4 asymmetric factions

• 24 campaign missions across 4 storylines, plus tutorial and custom skirmish

• 32 unit types, 12 hero commanders, and 14 structures

• 6 destructible biomes and 5 dynamic weather systems



Every PBR surface, volumetric flame, physical explosion, adaptive score, and 48kHz stereo sound effect is synthesized procedurally in real time, running in your browser at 60 FPS.
